common_prompt: You are annotating handwriting geometry, NOT transcribing or correcting it. Detect every visible PUPIL-HANDWRITTEN text line and every handwritten word on this notebook image. Ignore paper ruling, printed notebook elements, red margin rules, drawings, and wholly blank areas. Different ink colours may all belong to the pupil; exclude handwriting only when the image itself makes teacher authorship clear. Return ONLY one compact JSON object, no markdown, with normalized 0..1000 nested line and word boxes.

qwen.role: generic prompted base; NOT the R9 region adapter

glm.role: generic prompted vision model; NOT project GLM-OCR

metrics_note: Canonical comparison is line-count and whitespace-token-count error only. Pairwise box score is symmetric Dice agreement after greedy matching at IoU >= 0.25; it is agreement, not accuracy. Geometry is split into page-bound violations and word-parent containment escapes under one rule for all four detectors; ReadingPipeline containment escapes are expected from its independently padded line and word boxes and are not automatically errors.

excluded_visible_handwriting.reason: region blacked out / redacted in the image; any underlying handwriting is not visible
